name: I agree.
example: I agree with your idea.

name: Absolutely!
example: Absolutely! That's a great idea.

name: Exactly!
example: Exactly! I was thinking the same.

name: You're right.
example: You're right about that.

name: I think so too.
example: I think so too.

name: I don't agree.
example: I don't agree with that decision.

name: I disagree.
example: I respectfully disagree.

name: Not really.
example: Do you like it? Not really.

name: I don't think so.
example: Will it rain? I don't think so.

name: I'm not sure.
example: I'm not sure about that.

name: That's true.
example: That's true. I agree with you.

name: Fair enough.
example: Fair enough. Let's do it your way.

name: You have a point.
example: You have a point. Let's think about it.
exampleTamil: நீ சொல்வதில் நியாயம் இருக்கிறது. அதைப் பற்றி யோசிப்போம்.

name: I see your point.
example: I see your point, but I have another idea.
exampleTamil: உன் கருத்து எனக்கு புரிகிறது, ஆனால் எனக்கு வேறு ஒரு யோசனை இருக்கிறது.

name: Not at all.
example: Are you upset? Not at all.

name: I couldn't agree more.
example: I couldn't agree more with you.

name: I'm afraid not.
example: Can you come today? I'm afraid not.

name: That's not true.
example: That's not true at all.

name: I beg to differ.
example: I beg to differ on this issue.
exampleTamil: இந்த விஷயத்தில் நான் வேறுபட்ட கருத்தைக் கொண்டிருக்கிறேன்.

name: Let's agree to disagree.
example: We have different opinions. Let's agree to disagree.
exampleTamil: நமக்கு வெவ்வேறு கருத்துகள் உள்ளன. கருத்து வேறுபாட்டை ஏற்றுக்கொள்வோம்.
